grader_notes: Lesson 4 hits E1.4 cleanly: the over-overuse trap is grade-1 specific and recovery branches by diagnostic (cards, body modeling, prompted re-pick). Optional puppet path keeps materials universal. Worksheet varies practice (label, place, transfer to bedroom) — Part 3 deliberately bridges to home context. Math authenticity scores 3 rather than 4: lesson teaches precise positional language well but does not let children invent/compare strategies, nor does it cite spatial-reasoning research by name (Battista, Clements/Sarama). Conceptual progression (specificity over 'over') is explicit and vocabulary is precise.
